svg.title: Custom SGEMM as a race: three kernels fill the same 8 by 8 block of C in the same time, each getting as far as its measured throughput allows. Naive, 169.6 GFLOPS, reads its operands one at a time; coalesced, 763.1, takes a row per transaction; shared-memory tiling, 1,052.9, lifts a tile once into shared memory and reuses it. 6.5 times faster on an RTX 4060.
svg.text: 169.6 to 1,052.9 GFLOPS, one bottleneck at a time · 6.5× on an RTX 4060
